text:
Rekha: Heads-up — NovaPay reopened privacy/security items for the POC. Their security team wants DPA confirmation, SCCs for EU transfers, and clarity on DSAR handling + log retention. Can we assign owners? @Tom @Jenna

Tom: I’ll own the CAIQ/SIG answers. Do we have the latest CAIQ export? Prefer a PDF for their vendor portal.

Luis: I exported the CAIQ last week and added a short answers sheet. Link: https://redwood.atl/ca iq/novapay-ca iq (WIP). I will tidy and export PDF today.

Jenna: Legal note: we are data processor. We will sign our standard DPA and the EU SCCs for transfers. Need to confirm subprocessors list and any subprocessors in the flow for the POC.

Asha (NovaPay): Quick Q: For the POC we want to ingest tokenized PANs and need to know retention for request and debug logs. Also whether BYOK is available.

Tom: BYOK is available on Private deployments via HSM/KMS. For Dedicated we support customer-managed cloud KMS integrations. Hosted uses our managed keys by default.

Rekha: For logs: default retention is 30 days and we apply automated PII redaction rules. We can offer extended retention (90 days) on Dedicated/Hosted as a paid add-on. Private can be configured to customer needs.

Asha (NovaPay): 90 days is a hard requirement for us for the POC traceability. We also need a DSAR/deletion runbook — who performs deletions for Hosted vs Dedicated?

Jenna: DSARs: Hosted — we provide APIs to locate and delete customer content; SLA ~30 days to complete a full deletion workflow. Dedicated/Private — we provide the tooling + runbook; the customer's infra team usually triggers deletion; we assist as needed. We'll include step-by-step runbook in the bundle.

Luis: Security team also asked about caching/KV prefixes. Recommend disabling prefix/KV cache for POC when processing sensitive tokens. Note: that increases token cost/latency.

Tom: Action: I’ll attach CAIQ PDF + a one-page answers summary covering patch cadence, CVE response, network isolation, and subprocessors. Luis — can you add the exact redaction snippet?

Luis: Paste for sales blurb:

LOG_RETENTION_DAYS=30
PII_REDACTION=true
REDACTION_PATTERNS=regex:(PAN|ssn|email)
CACHE_PREFIXING=disabled_for_pii_workloads

I’ll check if regex can be extended to token formats.

Rekha: Pricing: extended retention is billed by GB/month as an add-on. Jenna, legal — do we need extra contract language for extended retention?

Jenna: We'll add a short appendix to the DPA quoting retention options and customer responsibilities. Also will publish the subprocessor list link and include instructions for requesting removal/clarifications.

Asha (NovaPay): Good. We require a signed DPA before we start ingesting real tokens. Can you send DPA + CAIQ PDF by EOD tomorrow?

Tom: Yes — I’ll drop the CAIQ PDF and the answers sheet into the vendor portal and cc you.

Luis: Also recommended: enable tokenization + disable prefix caching, ensure logs are routed to Private or Dedicated if you need longer retention.

Rekha: Summary of action items:
- Tom: CAIQ PDF + one-pager answers (today)
- Jenna: DPA + retention appendix (draft by EOD)
- Luis: confirm redaction regex and caching recommendation (tomorrow)
- Sales: add retention add-on line to the POC quote

Thanks — will follow up after docs uploaded. :thumbsup:
